reproducibility.sourceManifestEncoding: sorted relative source path, TAB, lowercase source SHA256, LF

method.name: TypeScript 7 AST statement/declaration logical units (custom, explicitly defined)
method.scope: Maintained shipping packages/*/src/**/*.ts only, excluding every feature/testing owner, root testing facades, core memory facade, .d.ts, and declaration-only pg-boss repair implementation/facades. No generated dist, dependencies, tools, examples, scenarios, fixtures or qualification code.
method.logicalLOC: Sum of runtimeStatementDeclarationUnits + moduleDirectiveUnits + typeDeclarationSignatureUnits. Each selected AST node counts once regardless of formatting.
method.runtimeStatementDeclarationUnits: All TypeScript isStatement nodes except Block, EmptyStatement, NotEmittedStatement, type declarations and module directives; plus class/object MethodDeclaration, PropertyDeclaration, Constructor, GetAccessor, SetAccessor, EnumMember, ClassStaticBlockDeclaration; plus VariableDeclarationList only when it is not wrapped by VariableStatement. Includes nested statements. A multi-declarator VariableStatement counts once. Expressions, arrow/function expressions, parameters, type references and property assignments are not extra units.
method.moduleDirectiveUnits: One per ImportDeclaration, ImportEqualsDeclaration, ExportDeclaration or ExportAssignment, including type-only imports/exports. Individual specifiers are not extra units.
method.typeDeclarationSignatureUnits: One per InterfaceDeclaration, TypeAliasDeclaration, PropertySignature, MethodSignature, CallSignature, ConstructSignature or IndexSignature, including nested type-literal signatures. Counts private as well as exported production type code. It is separate from runtime units and is not a count of public API members alone.
method.physicalNoncommentSLOC: Number of source lines containing at least one non-whitespace character after compiler-scanner comment spans are replaced with spaces. AST string/regex/template token spans are masked first, preserving whitespace/newlines, so comment-looking literal contents cannot create false comments. Includes braces/imports/type code and nonblank embedded SQL/template lines.
method.limits: This is an explicitly defined AST LLOC measure, not a universal industry standard, complexity score, emitted-JS count or count of nonblank physical lines. Type/member choices affect totals. Physical count is separately reported. SQL inside strings contributes physical SLOC but not additional TypeScript AST units.

historicalMethodRegression.note: Exact source hashes match even where FMS moved the file; every reported count field and selected syntax-kind count matches.
